title: Path Shape, Cross-Session Integrity, and Clustered Inference

baseline.branch_base_desc: phase-8 post-approval: cross-phase REPORT copy, open-items, library map
baseline.trunk_note: Escalation row 1 fired at T0: no `main` branch exists in this repo and the trunk `master` sat at 295a0e1 (phase-6b approved), containing zero Phase 8 files. Cooper's resolution (2026-08-03): fast-forward master to phase/8 HEAD (a clean FF, master was a strict ancestor, 0 divergence), then cut phase/9 from master. master and the phase/9 base are therefore both 6dd52cf. The one commit between the tag and the base adds results/reports/phase_8_report.md, docs/Open-Items-Register.md and docs/Research-Library-Map.md - no measurement code, no artifact.

objective: Repair the cross-session price-basis defect found in Phase 8's markouts, separate the three confounded axes (detection time-of-day / holding period / latency), and produce the first retracement measurement of the excursion itself.

read_only.rule: Zero passes over filtered_trades / filtered_quotes. Every quantity derives from event_minute_bars_v2 and frozen Phase 6b/8 artifacts.

universe.detection_universe_definition: D1 minus the 394 det_undefined events (tick T0 extended max never reaches 1.30x tick_close_t_minus_1_rth), per Phase 8 A10.3

data_source.minute_index_origin: 04:00:00 ET on the session's own date (index 0), same origin every offset
data_source.horizon_ceiling_rule: event_minute_bars_v2 carries session offsets -3..+3 only. T+3 is the hard horizon ceiling; no extrapolation beyond it. Stated in the report wherever a retracement figure appears.

d4.status: in force, extended by this phase
d4.rule: No spine numeric column (OHLC/volume on momentum_events) on any computation path. momentum_pct is diagnostic-display-only this phase and is NOT a bucketing variable.
d4.extension: The adjustment-basis mismatch D4 quarantined on the spine also exists in raw tick prices ACROSS a session boundary. Phase 8 applied the within-day guard and then computed cross-day ratios anyway. T1 closes that gap with a magnitude-only detector.
d4.reused_columns_note: Both tick_close_t_minus_1_rth and day_high_ext are tick-derived (a61/6b, D4-clean: a62_d4_sweep 0 measurement-path spine hits). Reused frozen, never recomputed.

flag_never_delete.rule: No event is dropped from any population. Suspect events are flagged, carried, and reported as their own row.
flag_never_delete.sensitivity_rule: Trimmed and flag-excluded variants ship ALONGSIDE the untrimmed primary, never instead of it.

ca_flag_log_threshold_desc: ln(1.8). |r| >= this marks flag_cross_session_extreme. MAGNITUDE ONLY - the detector encodes no corporate-action judgment.
ca_integer_tolerance_desc: relative tolerance around k or 1/k for the integer-clustering DIAGNOSTIC (T1b). Evidence about what the flagged set is; not part of the flag.
trim_ratio_bounds_desc: variant (iv) keeps pairs whose price ratio exp(r) lies inside these bounds
horizon_definition: last extended-session print (max minute_index bar) on the named session offset
latency_note: det+0 is a physical impossibility, included only as the upper bound of the ladder; labelled as such on every chart

t1_cross_session_detector.session_pairs_desc: every ordered session pair used anywhere in Phase 8 or Phase 9
t1_cross_session_detector.ratio_definition: r = log(p_later_close / p_earlier_close), from event_minute_bars_v2 last-trade prices only
t1_cross_session_detector.price_field: last_price of the max-minute_index bar on that session offset (extended day, any segment)
t1_cross_session_detector.flag_home_rule: Homed in the phase-9 artifact, parallel to flag_possible_row_cap. NOT added to src/data/canonical.py without Cooper's instruction (T1d; also 'nothing in src/ changes mid-phase').

t2_variants.i_untrimmed_all: every pair, no exclusion - the PRIMARY
t2_variants.ii_flagged_separate: flagged carried but reported as their own row alongside the unflagged

t2_cells.mean_simple_definition: mean of (exp(r) - 1), the simple return - this is the statistic that sign-flipped in the Phase 8 inspection

t3_retracement.retrace_excursion: (H - p_h) / (H - A), defined only where H - A > 0
t3_retracement.retrace_excursion_undefined: reuse 6b denom_nonpositive (n=5), carried as its own row
t3_retracement.retrace_detection: (H - p_h) / (H - p_det), defined only where H - p_det > 0; the rest carried as retrace_det_undefined with its own n
t3_retracement.reading: 0 = still at the high. 1.0 = fully back to the T-1 RTH close. >1.0 = below it.

level_crossing_census.below_A: share of events where p_h < A (fully round-tripped)
level_crossing_census.below_det: share of events where p_h < p_det (below the detection level)

t3_retracement.ca_variant: T3a-T3c recomputed with flag_cross_session_extreme events carried separately. All T+1/T+2/T+3 figures ship in both variants.

t4_axis_separation.motivation: Phase 8 §19 confounded detection time-of-day with holding period, and §19's latency claim confounded latency with holding period. Holding period becomes an explicit independent axis here.

fixed_exit_grid.note: the only axis where latency is unconfounded by hold length
fixed_exit_grid.report: full distribution per latency, not just the median

t4_axis_separation.attrition: n attrition reported per cell across the latency axis, so it is visible that changes are not sample composition
t4_axis_separation.thin_cell_rule: cells with n < 100 are hatched and carry no claim (escalation row 11 - presenting one unhatched is a hard stop)

t5_clustered_inference.motivation: D1 contains 15,763 events across ~2,576 distinct tickers (mean 6.1/ticker, max 57; 59% of events sit in tickers with >=10 events). Nominal n materially overstates independent observations.
t5_clustered_inference.method: ticker-block bootstrap - resample TICKERS with replacement, take all events of each drawn ticker
applied_to: t0_close->t1_close pooled and per pq_rth_open quintile
det+5 -> t0_close pooled and per det_bin
companion_statistics: share of tickers with negative median
t5_clustered_inference.naive_ci: reported side by side with the block CI on chart 08

t6_runway_split.known_shape: not unimodal: 2,013 events (12.8%) runway exactly 0, 19.9% <=1 min, 30.6% <=5 min, then a second mass at 120-480 min
t6_runway_split.trough: located EMPIRICALLY. Do not assume a cut point.
t6_runway_split.prohibition: runway_minutes is NOT anchor-knowable and must never be used as a markout bucket (Phase 8 escalation row 11 applies; Phase 9 escalation row 12). It is a diagnostic split only. Stated in the report.

charts.engine: plotly, standalone HTML, one per file, kaleido-verified (.png sibling)
charts.rules: distribution not just center; n per bucket always; no smoothing; log axes where multiplicative; outliers shown never clipped

reporting.no_recommendations: escalation row 14 - no recommendation, no characterisation of any result as good/weak/promising/disappointing
reporting.horizon_ceiling_statement: T+3 ceiling stated explicitly wherever a retracement figure is reported
reporting.n_rule: every statistic carries n; every claim cites its chart file

config_hash_note: This file is committed before any measurement. Outputs key on its content hash.
write_allowlist_note: escalation row 13 - any write outside these is a hard stop
